LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Setup.LetterText:
Crew, your away mission is to establish a small perimeter, deploy the subspace sensor array, and survey two alien obelisks detected from orbit.
1) Build and power a Subspace Sensor near each obelisk. 2) Perform a scan on both obelisks. 3) Transmit the collected telemetry to Starfleet via the beacon.
Starfleet notes: Local fauna exhibits irregular bioelectric responses to subspace harmonics. Disturbances may occur once telemetry is broadcast.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Spawned.Title: Obelisks located
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Spawned.Text: We have pinpointed two alien obelisks on this world. Their surface glyphs are consistent with unknown pre-warp symbology. Establish the sensors and begin scans.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.ScanA.OrderText: Bring the Subspace Sensor online near the first obelisk and start a scan. Keep a security cordon—ambient wildlife may react to the subspace ping.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.ScanA.SuccessText: The first obelisk’s subspace lattice has been mapped. Proceed to the second site and repeat the procedure.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.ScanB.OrderText: Power the sensor near the second obelisk and complete the scan to finish the local survey.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.ScanB.SuccessText: We now hold a paired dataset of harmonic glyph patterns. Consolidate the results and transmit to Starfleet from the communications beacon.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Transmit.OrderText: Use the beacon’s “Report to Starfleet” function to uplink the consolidated obelisk data. Expect local fauna agitation once the broadcast energizes the ionosphere.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Transmit.SentText: Starfleet confirms receipt. Stand by for preliminary analysis. Maintain a defensive posture until local conditions stabilize.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Manhunt.Title: Faunal disturbance detected
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Manhunt.Text: Subspace emission has triggered aggressive behavior in nearby wildlife. Hold the line and protect the equipment until the disturbance passes.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.II.Cleared.Title: Subspace window stabilized
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.II.Cleared.Text: The immediate threat has passed. Starfleet requests your recommendation on how to proceed with the obelisk sites.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseIII.ThreatText: Local fauna is agitated by the subspace window. Prepare for another attack.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseIII.Title: Obelisk Survey — Phase III
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseIII.Desc: Directive required. Subspace window is stable; select how to proceed with the sites.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Choice.Title: Directive required
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Choice.Text: To avoid an incident, we can secure the site under Starfleet protocol—or move decisively to reach the presumed vault before claimants converge.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseIV.Title: Obelisk Survey — Phase IV (Warden)
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseIV.Desc: Impose the Warden’s protocol and secure the sites against interference.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseIV.LetterText: Proceed to secure the sites under Starfleet authority.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseIV.DoneText: The area is stabilized under Warden rules.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseV.Title: Obelisk Survey — Phase V (Vault)
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseV.Desc: Race claimants to the presumed vault and recover its contents.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseV.DoneText: The vault has been cleared and artifacts secured.
